title: Modern Web Application Development | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Modern Web Application Development. Category: Development. Duration: 12 months. Description: Build and deploy full-featured mobile applications using React Native, going from JavaScript fundamentals to advanced concepts like async programming, OOP, and functional patterns, then applying that to cross-platform iOS and Android apps. Eligibility: Matric. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
